description.en: A gorgeous production of HGUCKit! Introducing the extended effect unit “Wings of Light” for V2 Gundam! !

description.en: Spread your wings of light and recreate the scenes from the movie! !

description.ja: ●　２色の光の翼！
description.en: ● Wings of two-colored light!

description.ja: 劇中の印象的なシーンを再現するクリアブルーとクリアピンクの成形色のエフェクト×２組が付属。

description.en: Can be installed on HGUC V2 Gundam (sold separately) and HGUC V2 Assault Buster Gundam (sold separately).

description.ja: シャープな印象の成形キット！　放射状の光の表現をモールドで再現！　２つのカラーは両キットに対応！
description.en: A molding kit with a sharp impression! Reproduce the expression of radial light with a mold! Two colors are compatible with both kits!

description.ja: ●　専用スタンド付属！
description.en: ● Dedicated stand included!
